news.raw_snippet:
That carrying value already reflects Anthropic's $965 billion valuation from its May 2026 funding round.

## A $100 billion cloud deal ties Amazon's AI future to one company

Anthropic committed to spending more than $100 billion on AWS cloud infrastructure and custom chips over the next decade, Fortune reported.

Story Continues [...] Amazon has no comparable option, as its cloud AI offerings center on Claude, and without that model, AWS would lack a frontier offering to compete with Azure's OpenAI integration or Google Cloud's native Gemini access.

More IPO:

   Popular menswear retailer plans Wall Street return six years after bankruptcy

   Anthropic just made a move that changes the AI investing story

   Wall Street's $200 billion IPO wave threatens sell-off [...] Amazon, unlike every other major Anthropic backer, has no competitive in-house frontier AI model. Alphabet built Gemini and Microsoft locked in OpenAI, but Amazon built its cloud AI strategy around Claude.

The company reinforced that bet on Amazon's April 20, 2026, announcement with an expanded strategic collaboration.

As part of the agreement, Anthropic committed over $100 billion over 10 years to Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies, while securing up to 5 gigawatts of Trainium capacity.

news.title: Nscale Raises $3.36 Billion In Pre-IPO Convertible Financing Led By Third Point
news.snippet: The deal provides Nscale with additional capital as it pursues large-scale AI in...
news.raw_snippet:
The deal provides Nscale with additional capital as it pursues large-scale AI infrastructure development and expands its capacity to serve customers requiring substantial computing resources.

Support: Goldman Sachs & Co. served as placement agent for Nscale in connection with the financing.

KEY QUOTES: [...] Nscale, a London-based artificial intelligence cloud infrastructure company, has raised $3.36 billion through a pre-IPO convertible loan note financing led by Third Point. The financing will support the expansion of its vertically integrated AI cloud platform, including data centers, power infrastructure, and large-scale GPU computing clusters. [...] For most investors, the notes will convert into ordinary shares. NVIDIA’s notes will instead convert into nonvoting shares.

The announcement did not disclose the financing’s conversion valuation, interest rate, or maturity terms.

Nscale has reported more than $103 billion in total contracted value, reflecting its commercial agreements across its AI infrastructure business.

Team & Function Building

What It Takes

8+ years in comms, PR, brand, content, editorial or journalism or founder/exec visibility somewhere in there. (Or a portfolio strong enough to make years irrelevant.) [...] We’re a well-funded, early-stage startup, hiring our Director of Brand & Communications to build and own our brand and narrative function from the ground up. [...] A track record of earned media and/or founder thought leadership you can point to: placements you landed, bylines you shaped, voices you built.

Existing media instincts and ideally relationships you know what makes a story land and you're comfortable pitching it yourself.

A portfolio or writing samples showing range and a distinct voice: positioning you've shaped plus published work (essays, launches, campaigns, coverage) you can say "I made that" about.
